aim_summary.goal: Add a radiator filling system comprising a pouring section and a cap.
aim_summary.expected_outcome: The radiator has a pouring section that permits filling flow and a corresponding cap that closes the filling access, while unrelated radiator geometry remains unchanged.

operations_plan.summary: Create the pouring section and its fluid opening on the radiator housing.

steps.description: Add an annular pouring section to the radiator housing at the requested filling-system interface.
Create the filling passage through the radiator interface, coaxial with the pouring section.

expected_result.geometry: A pouring section with an open fluid passage exists on the radiator as part of the filling system.
expected_result.function: The pouring section provides access for filling the radiator.
expected_result.behavior: The open pouring section permits fluid to pass into the radiator during filling.

validation_criteria.description: A pouring section is present on the radiator and has a passage communicating with the radiator interior.
The pouring section provides filling access to the radiator.
The pouring section permits fluid entry into the radiator.
Non-targeted radiator geometry remains unchanged except at the necessary pouring-section interface.

operations_plan.summary: Create and place a cap corresponding to the radiator pouring section.

steps.description: Create the cap as a separate revolved component compatible with the pouring section.
Insert the cap at a placement corresponding to and closing the pouring section.

expected_result.geometry: A separate cap exists on the radiator filling system and corresponds to the pouring section.
expected_result.function: The cap closes the filling access associated with the pouring section.
expected_result.behavior: The cap covers or closes the pouring section when filling access is not in use.

validation_criteria.description: A cap is present and geometrically corresponds to the pouring section of the radiator filling system.
The cap can close the filling access associated with the pouring section.
In its closed placement, the cap covers or constrains the pouring-section opening.
Non-targeted radiator geometry remains unchanged except for necessary filling-system interfaces.
